subject: Correction: exact linked VkFormat counts for 12 fetch-refused VS-texture jobs
body:
Acknowledged. STATUS corrected and survey tool now reads saved translation metadata when the native fetch API zeroes its output.

Exact linked formats across the 12 fetch-refused jobs: VkFormat106 x10, 103 x24, 83 x32, 97 x22. All 12 include VkFormat83 (R16G16_SFLOAT); 97/103/106 are already in the native supported set. So this is one missing format (83), not the Metal descriptor values 29/25/27. Icon graphics-01134 metadata is [103,83,97,103]. The job descriptors are synthetic tightly packed inputs, not captured runtime layouts; I no longer describe these as 12 captured real layout failures. Backend expansion request is therefore exact: accept VkFormat83 in air_bridge.rs and map it in vertex_fetch.c/n2r, with an independently derived hardware format descriptor and a negative/boundary test. I am not editing those files.
